newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyo Engineering to design Thai refinery.
newsitem.headline: Toyo Engineering to design Thai refinery.

text.p: Toyo Engineering Corp said on Monday that it had received an order to design a new 125,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery for Thailand's Sukhothai Petroleum Co Ltd.
A Toyo Engineering spokesman said the two companies had also basically agreed that Toyo would build the plant, although a formal agreement has yet to be signed.

The spokesman said the design order was worth roughly two billion yen. The cost of building the plant will not be known until the design is completed, but he said such refineries usually cost more than $1 billion.
The refinery will be built in southern Thailand's Songkhla, near the border with Malaysia.
The refinery, which is due to begin operating from the summer of 2000, will refine crude from the Middle East.
Some 80 percent of the refined products will be exported to neighbouring countries where there is a growing demand for oil products, the spokesman said.
